newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers sold steady, instances $.50 lower. - USDA

Slaughter Steers - Part Load Choice predominantly 3, blacks near 1370 lbs 69.25. High Select and Choice 2-3, 1200-1350 lbs 67.50-69.00. Select and Choice 2-3, 1100-1300 lbs 66.00-67.50. Select 1-2, 63.50-66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - High Select and Choice 2-3, 1050-1250 lbs 67.00-69.00. Select and Choice 2-3, 950-1100 lbs 64.00-67.00. Select 1-2, 63.00-64.50.
